description: This endorsement is especially meaningful. Congressman Joe Neguse grew up in Highlands Ranch and attended ThunderRidge High School in the Douglas County School District. He knows our schools, our neighborhoods, and our community firsthand.I’m honored to have his endorsement for Colorado State Senate District 30.But endorsements alone won’t win this election. People will—and I need your help.🚪 Join Me Canvassing This Saturday!📅 Saturday, September 19 • 10:00 AM📍 Highland Heritage Regional Park
